name: 4th Grade Math
description: Multi-digit arithmetic, negative numbers, fractions, decimals, lines and angles in geometry.

name: 5th Grade Math
description: Arithmetic with fractions and decimals. Solve real-world problems involving measurement, data, and geometry.

name: 6th Grade Math
description: Ratios, percentages, fraction division, expressions, equations, geometry, and statistics.

name: 7th Grade Math
description: Proportional relationships, multi-step equations, geometry, statistics, and probability.

name: 8th Grade Math
description: Exponents, scientific notation, equations, graphs, functions, geometry, and transformations.

name: Prealgebra
description: Variables, linear equations and inequalities, systems of equations, expressions, ratios, and the distributive property.

name: Algebra I
description: Functions, graphing, linear and quadratic equations, factoring, exponents, and systems.

name: Geometry
description: Length, area, and volume. Relationships between angles and side lengths in right triangles. Coordinate geometry.

name: Algebra II
description: Advanced functions: quadratics, logarithms, trigonometry, and polynomials. Complex numbers and sequences.

name: Precalculus
description: Functions, polynomials, rational and exponential functions, conics, vectors, parametric and polar curves, sequences and series, and advanced trigonometry.

name: Calculus I
description: Limits, continuity, derivatives, differentiation rules and applications, and definite integrals.

name: Calculus II
description: Integration techniques, improper integrals, sequences and series, power and Taylor series.

name: Calculus III
description: Multivariable and vector calculus: parametrised curves, curvature, line integrals, multiple integrals and the Jacobian.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Vectors, matrices, determinants, systems, eigenvalues, spans and bases, linear transformations, inner products, and matrix decompositions.

name: Discrete Math
description: Logic, sets, combinatorics, graphs, recurrence, and induction.

name: Discrete Math II
description: De Morgan, relations, pigeonhole, Eulerian, and strong induction.

name: Probability & Statistics
description: Descriptive statistics, probability, distributions, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and the tests built on them.

name: Number Theory
description: Divisibility, primes, modular arithmetic, Euler's theorem, quadratic residues, continued fractions, and cryptography.

name: Differential Equations
description: First and second order ODEs, series and numerical methods, systems, applications, an introduction to partial differential equations, and the Laplace transform.

name: Abstract Algebra
description: Groups, subgroups, homomorphisms, rings, and fields.

name: Abstract Algebra II
description: Normal subgroups, Lagrange, quotient groups, polynomial rings, and field extensions.

name: Topology
description: Metric spaces, open and closed sets, continuity, compactness, connectedness, and an introduction to algebraic topology.

name: Machine Learning
description: Vector foundations and backpropagation through neural networks.

name: Complex Numbers and Analysis
description: Complex arithmetic and geometry, polar and exponential form, roots, and the beginnings of complex analysis.

name: Graph Theory
description: Isomorphism, connectivity, matchings, coloring, planarity, spectra, extremal graphs, flows, and structural decompositions.

name: Probability Theory
description: The axioms, conditional probability, random variables, distributions, generating functions and limit theorems.

name: Numerical Analysis
description: Error and conditioning, root finding, interpolation and approximation, quadrature, and numerical linear algebra.

name: Real Analysis
description: The completeness of the real line, sequences and series, limits and continuity, and the core theorems of the calculus, developed rigorously.

name: Optimization
description: Formulate an optimization problem, classify its geometry, apply first-order and second-order conditions, and solve constrained and discrete models.
